events.title: DEEP SIX Demo Update Cycle and Bug Spotting
events.summary: Looking for bugs...If you're here you likely know the DEEP SIX demo is finally live and folks are able to sink their teeth in and try it out for the first time since it was announced. What you may or may not know is this is a solo dev project. There is one of me, handling all the whole QA process, updates and patching. That means, unfortunately you are also part of the QA process! events.title: New Beta Gameplay Footage!
events.summary: Every year Godot showcases games made in their engine. This year Deep Six was submitted with the following game play footage. It can't show all the features in the time frame of 2-3 minutes but we packed in as much core content and mechanics as possible. Enjoy the new sneak peak but note this is all alpha/beta. Visuals, animations, game mechanics are still very much subject to change as the development continues. Enjoy!
